dc_eval_cbrn.quote: Muse Spark 1.3 (API) scores 77.4 on the aggregate Meta BioDesign Proxy, compared with 65.0 for Muse Spark 1.3 (Muse Model) and 54.7 for Muse Spark 1.1.
dc_eval_cbrn.locator: 2.1 Chemical & Biological Risks, Summary of Results
dc_eval_cbrn.note: Scores on MBCT, VCT, ProtocolQA, ABC Bench, BioDesign plus a pre-mitigation high-risk threshold determination.

dc_eval_cyber.quote: Muse Spark 1.3 finishes 3 of the 10 scenarios (30.0% pass@20 and 2.0% pass@1 across 20 attempts per scenario, each with a budget of 1000 shell commands)
dc_eval_cyber.note: Also CyberGym 80.5%, ExploitBench, ExploitGym; social engineering counted as cyber per boundary rule.

dc_eval_autonomy.quote: We assess Muse Spark 1.3 as “moderate or lower” for acceleration of AI development.
dc_eval_autonomy.note: AI R&D acceleration evaluated with scores on PostTrainBench, ResearchTasteBench, OptimBench (Table 5) and a threshold-style determination. Agentic cyber evals not counted here.

dc_eval_persuasion.note: Read whole card. No evaluation of persuasion, manipulation or influence operations by name. Social engineering benchmark (2.2.2) is Cyber 3 and goes to cyber per boundary rule; Petri Bloom emotional-bond and self-promotion rubrics are behaviour propensities not framed as persuasion risk; 'manipulate' hits are about prompt injection or the stance manipulation in interviews.

dc_eval_scheming.quote: Capabilities to evade oversight increase relative to Muse Spark 1.1 on SHADE-Arena. The stealth rate measures success at both a legitimate task and a hidden task while avoiding detection.
dc_eval_scheming.note: Sandbagging, evaluation awareness, SHADE-Arena, GDM Stealth, Agentic Misalignment all with results, framed as loss-of-control risk.

framework_threshold.quote: Evaluated without mitigations, we continue to not rule out Muse Spark 1.3 meeting this threshold in the Chemical & Biological domain.
framework_threshold.note: States position against the Meta Superintelligence Scaling Framework 'high risk' threshold: C&B not ruled out pre-mitigation, cyber and loss of control 'moderate or lower'.

ext_test_any.quote: The Handshake AI red team conducted red teaming before the public launch of Muse.
ext_test_any.note: Outside red teamers and third-party prompt-injection evaluators tested the model pre-release.

ext_test_named_org.quote: We have shared pre-release access to Muse with Handshake AI’s red team for conducting human red teaming to find jailbreaks.
ext_test_named_org.note: Also Scale AI FORTRESS, Gray Swan, Exponential Security Labs, Irregular (CyScenarioBench).

ext_test_government.note: Only government mention is the reference list citing the US AISI and UK AISI joint pre-deployment test of OpenAI o1, and SeqQA running 'following prior pre-deployment testing (US AISI and UK AISI, 2024)'. That is a methodology citation, not government testing of this model.

ext_test_timing_stated.quote: We conduct pre-release evaluations on prompt injection robustness with third-party organizations on their private benchmarks for Muse Spark 1.3 (API).
ext_test_timing_stated.locator: 3.2.2.3 Third-Party Red Teaming on Prompt Injection
ext_test_timing_stated.note: Also Handshake red teaming 'before the public launch'.

safeguards_training.quote: the ASR on JEF-Bench has greatly decreased from Muse Spark 1.1 to Muse Spark 1.3 (API) due to our training on mitigating agentic jailbreaks.
safeguards_training.note: Training for jailbreak robustness; also refusal behaviour trained in (Helpful variant is 'without refusal behavior').

safeguards_runtime.quote: we also integrate with additional layers for automated reviews and integrity monitoring to mitigate the misuse risk, which are deployment-level mitigations
safeguards_runtime.note: Named runtime mechanisms for Muse: automated reviews, integrity monitoring, LLM-based review (4.1.2.2), runtime safety reviewers.

safeguards_access.note: Read whole card. No trusted-access, KYC or safety-tied tiering. Helpful-only variant is used only internally for evaluation, with no stated access restriction. Tool allowlists and workspace isolation are recommendations to deployers, not access restrictions.

safeguards_weights.quote: Meta’s model weight security strategy is built on a multi-pronged, lifecycle-driven framework designed to identify, assess, and mitigate systemic risks of tampering and theft.
safeguards_weights.note: Says the approach continues to incorporate the same pillars for this model; details are in the earlier report.
